title: Combinatorial Residual Network: a decay-chain-aware classifier without explicit jet assignment
abstract: arXiv:2610.40749v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Final states with several jets from the decays of heavy particles pose a combinatorial problem, since the jets must be assigned, at least implicitly, to their parent particles. We describe the Combinatorial Residual Network (CoReNet), a classifier that encodes the assumed decay chain of the final state in its architecture. CoReNet builds its event representation level by level along the decay hierarchy, evaluates every jet assignment hypothesis with weights shared across objects, and combines the hypotheses with learned weights using residual networks. The exchange symmetries of the decay are built into the construction, the size of the network does not depend on the number of hypotheses, and the network is trained with the classification loss alone, without generator-level jet assignments. The architecture was developed for the $b\bar{b}b\bar{b}$ final state and has been used in several CMS searches. On fast-simulation samples of Higg

translated_title: 组合残差网络：一种无需显式喷注分配的衰变链感知分类器
translated_abstract: 由重粒子衰变产生的包含多个喷注的末态带来了一个组合问题，因为至少需要隐式地将喷注分配给它们的母粒子。我们描述了组合残差网络，这是一种在其架构中编码了末态假设衰变链的分类器。CoReNet沿着衰变层级逐级构建事件表示，使用跨对象共享的权重评估每一个喷注分配假设，并通过残差网络以学习到的权重将这些假设组合起来。衰变的交换对称性被内置于该构造之中，网络的规模不依赖于假设的数量，且网络仅通过分类损失进行训练，无需发生器级别的喷注分配标签。该架构最初是为 $b\bar{b}b\bar{b}$ 末态开发的，并已应用于多个CMS搜索中。（注：所提供的摘要在“On fast-simulation samples of Higg...”处被截断，故摘要翻译不完整）
tldr: 该论文提出CoReNet，一种将假设衰变链直接编码进网络架构的分类器，通过逐级构建事件表示并用残差网络组合喷注分配假设，无需显式喷注分配或发生器级别标签即可解决多喷注末态的组合问题，并已在多个CMS搜索中得到应用。
